'''Daniel Lazard''' (born December 10, 1941) is a [[French people|French]] [[mathematician]] and [[computer scientist]]. He is emeritus professor at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]].

== Career ==
Daniel Lazard was born in [[Carpentras]], in southern [[France]].{{cn|date=February 2023}} His undergraduate education was at the [[École Normale Supérieure]].{{cn|date=February 2023}} Following graduate work at the École Normale Supérieure and the [[University of Paris]], he was granted a [[doctorat d'état]] in 1968 by the [[University of Paris]].  His dissertation was supervised by the [[commutative algebra]]ist [[Pierre Samuel]], and was titled ''"Autour de la platitude"'' ("Around flatness", or literally "Around the platitude").<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=90761}}.</ref><ref>{{cite thesis|url= https://catalogue.bib.ens.psl.eu/record=b1048807~S25*frf |title=Autour de la platitude|type=Thèse de doctorat|publisher=École Normale Supérieure (library record)|last=Lazard|first=Daniel|access-date=March 10, 2023}}</ref>

After 1970, his main area of research changed to [[computer algebra]], particularly [[multivariate polynomial]]s,  [[algebraic geometry#Computational algebraic geometry|computational algebraic geometry]] and [[systems of polynomial equations]]. To mark his retirement at the end of 2004,<!-- Commented out irretrievable broken link that originally referenced his retirement in 2008.<ref>https://ac.els-cdn.com/S0747717108001090/1-s2.0-S0747717108001090-main.pdf?_tid=432ac271-f018-4959-b17a-a56d24fecb96&acdnat=1540752648_2b667a61e5a57bb42441a6bee8e0d4e8 {{Bare URL PDF|date=August 2022}}</ref> --> there was a conference at Pierre and Marie Curie University devoted to his subject area.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20090314084239/http://www-calfor.lip6.fr/ICPSS/conf.html "International Conference on Polynomial System Solving, Paris, November 24-25-26 2004, in honour of Daniel Lazard"], LIP6, archived from [http://www-calfor.lip6.fr/ICPSS/conf.html the original] on March 14, 2009.</ref> In 2009, a special issue of the ''[[Journal of Symbolic Computation]]'' was published in his honor.<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Faugère |first1=Jean-Charles |last2=Rouillier |first2=Fabrice |date=2009-03-01 |title=Foreword |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0747717108001090 |journal=[[Journal of Symbolic Computation]] |series=Polynomial System Solving in honor of Daniel Lazard |language=en |volume=44 |issue=3 |pages=221 |doi=10.1016/j.jsc.2008.08.004 |issn=0747-7171|url-access=subscription }}</ref> To date, Lazard has authored or co-authored more than 40 journal articles, book chapters, conference papers, and other publications.<ref>{{Cite web |title=LAZARD Daniel 1998-2021 Publications |url=https://www.lip6.fr/actualite/personnes-fiche.php?ident=P376 |access-date=February 23, 2023 |website=Sorbonne Institute}}</ref>
